projects.description: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
projects.readme_excerpt:
cargo install --path apps/craft-anything-cli         # the CLI, as `craft-anything-cli`
craft-anything-cli doctor                            # checks the install, coding agents and engines
```

Building needs a coding agent signed in on your computer (see [AI](#ai)); `doctor` says what's
missing. Rebuild from the command line (questions are asked in the terminal):

```sh
craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Recreate this website"
craft-anything-cli rebuild - "A snake game in Rust" --rounds 1
craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com "Make the header blue" --continue-in "<project folder>"
craft-anything-cli rebuild - "Add a contact form" --project-folder "<your folder>" --existing edit
```

New projects go in `Documents/Craft Anything` (change it in Settings → General). Each project
folder holds `craft.json` (the request, target, status and history), `capture/` (what was
recorded from the target), `app/` (the generated project), `checks/` (each comparison against
the original), `investigation.cany/` (evidence) and `inbox/` (open questions).

A project can also start in a folder you pick (Choose a folder… under Start, or `--project-folder`).

projects.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
projects.readme_excerpt:
This runs Auto-Ontology with Docker Compose against Wide World Importers,
Microsoft's sample sales database. You need Docker with Compose v2,
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), and an NVIDIA API key (`nvapi-...`) from
[build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com).

1. Clone the repository and create `.env`:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/auto-ontology.git && cd auto-ontology
   cp .env.example .env
   ```

   Then set these values in `.env`:

   ```dotenv
   DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY=nvapi-...
   AUTH_SECRET=<a long random string, e.g. from openssl rand -base64 32>
   APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
   POSTGRES_PASSWORD=<a new password>
   CONNECTION_STRINGS=postgresql://postgres:<the same password>@postgres:5432/wideworldimporters
   AUTO_ONTOLOGY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<a new password>
   PGADMIN_PASSWORD=<a new password>
   ```

   Compose publishes Postgres, pgAdmin, and the web app on the host, so replace
   each default password before you start it. `.env.example` also sets an API
   key per model role: replace each `nvapi-your-api-key-here` with your key, or
   delete those lines so they fall back to `DEFAULT_MODELS_API_KEY`.

projects.readme_intro: Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own.
